messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first action change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands with hands on hips, sways and shifts her weight, then turns around to face the camera while smiling and gesturing with one hand.","camera":"Low-angle full-body shot that slowly pushes in and follows her as she turns.","clothing":"Pink-and-white gingham sleeveless top with a white off-shoulder wrap, black shorts, and blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Red hair tied back in a high ponytail with loose strands framing the face.","identity":"A 3D animated woman with dark skin and a slim build, shown from behind and then turning to face the camera.","scene":"A wet, reflective rooftop or elevated walkway in a stylized city with tall buildings, neon signs, and construction cranes under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a fairground with Ferris wheel and ticket booth to a wet reflective city rooftop with tall buildings, neon signs, and construction cranes matching the reference. The woman, red ponytail, gingham top, white wrap, black shorts, and dance/turn action remain largely consistent, and the camera continues a low-angle push-in.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the amusement-park scene with the reference city rooftop environment while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression and subtle pose timing are perfectly identical to the source.
unexpected_changes: The person's shoes appear blue in the output rather than the lighter gray/white sneakers seen in the source.
